13: ANÍSYA. You'd better ask her. How do I know what the devil took her there!
11: MÍTRITCH. Why shouldn't one make merry if one has the money? And why did Akoulína go to town?
8: ANÍSYA. What need has he to hurry? He's got money. Merry-making with that girl, I daresay …
6: MÍTRITCH. What d'you think? Got it all as it should be, and covered everything with straw! I don't like doing things by halves! Oh Lord! holy Nicholas! [ Picks at the corns on his hands ] But it's time he was back.
4: ANÍSYA. Have you finished in the stackyard?
1: MÍTRITCH. Must have been on the spree. Oh Lord!
